title: MED+250 production security and catalogue contract deployment
summary: The reviewed database migrations were applied to production and the migration ledger was reconciled through the transactionally audited catalogue contract release.

checks.name: Migration ledger alignment
checks.detail: All 55 local MED+250 migration versions are present in the production ledger with matching migration names.

checks.name: Publication audit enforcement
checks.detail: Production now rejects approved or rejected catalogue states that lack a matching immutable audit event for that row version.

checks.name: Deployment contract refresh
checks.detail: The production backend contract was refreshed to version 2026-07-16.7 after the migration completed.
